name: akeneo
description: Reads Akeneo PIM products, categories, families, attributes, channels, product models, family variants, attribute groups, association types, locales, currencies, and measure families, and writes create-or-update upserts for the 9 catalog-structure resources, through the Akeneo REST API (OAuth2 password grant).

risk.read: external Akeneo PIM API read of product, category, family, attribute, channel, product-model, family-variant, attribute-group, association-type, locale, currency, and measure-family data
risk.write: external Akeneo PIM API upsert (create-or-update, PATCH-based) of products, categories, families, attributes, channels, product models, family variants, attribute groups, and association types; schema-shaping mutations (family/attribute/attribute-group) affect every product referencing them, approval required
